title: ee.session_budget.plan.v1
description: Advisory, deterministic, explainable next-command plan emitted by `ee session-budget plan`. Reads the opt-in ledger and current degraded-source posture to recommend the cheapest useful next command (primer, recall, ask, search, swarm-brief, pack, proof-wait, proof-skip). Never recommends local cargo. Includes rationale and fallback commands for each degraded source.

advisory.description: Always true — the plan is advisory and never mandates actions.

taskHint.description: Free-text task description passed by the caller (omitted if not provided).

recommendation.description: The single cheapest useful command given current posture.

fallbacks.description: Up to three ordered alternatives (ascending effective cost).

refusals.description: Commands refused by the planner (e.g., local cargo) with alternatives.

ledgerSummary.description: Aggregate statistics from the opt-in session-budget ledger.

command.description: Canonical shell command or advisory comment string.

estimatedCostMs.description: Estimated wall-clock cost in milliseconds (includes degraded penalty when applicable).

estimatedOutputTokens.description: Estimated output token count (0 for advisory-only entries).

degradedPenalty.description: True if a degraded-source penalty was added to this entry's cost.

input.description: The input string or command that was refused.

totalWallClockMs.description: Sum of wallClockMs across all ledger rows.

mostRecentSurface.description: Surface name of the most recently recorded command.

degradedEventCount.description: Number of rows that had at least one degradedGroup entry.
